messages.subject: September time entry - outstanding narratives
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Month-end billing closes at 5pm on Thursday 2 October. Our records show unposted time and missing narratives for several of you for the week commencing 22 September. Please ensure all time is entered and narratives completed so we can issue bills on schedule.

A reminder that narratives should be matter-specific and avoid generic descriptions such as 'various'.

Thank you
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
